CVE-2026-125704.title: A use-after-free flaw was found in GStreamer core buffer value de ...
CVE-2026-125704.description: A use-after-free flaw was found in GStreamer core buffer value deserialization. When crafted serialized buffer data contains an invalid character, an error path frees a mapped buffer before unmapping it. An application that parses untrusted caps or structure data could crash; a network-facing GStreamer Data Protocol receiver can process such data without user interaction. Further impact has not been established.

CVE-2026-1940.title: An incomplete fix for CVE-2024-47778 allows an out-of-bounds read ...
CVE-2026-1940.description: An incomplete fix for CVE-2024-47778 allows an out-of-bounds read in gst_wavparse_adtl_chunk() function. The patch added a size validation check lsize + 8 > size, but it does not account for the GST_ROUND_UP_2(lsize) used in the actual offset calculation. When lsize is an odd number, the parser advances more bytes than validated, causing OOB read.
